title: The first twelve weeks: the employee-experience blueprint with its owners
subtitle: Six stages from pre-start to established, with a lane for each role that owns part of the experience and a measures lane that says what counts as done. Failure points are the moments the survey evidence and the attrition chain located.

lanes.name: Crew (frontstage)
cells: Uniform, access and first roster confirmed || Readiness pack: uniform, user ID, learning access, a named buddy.
Introduced, toured, first station || Welcome script, station tour, a who-to-ask card.
Structured training plan || The plan is the artefact, not the module list.
Station progression starts || A skills ladder with visible sign-off per station.
Independence builds || Solo station time with escalation rights.
Next skill visible || Cross-training and a named next opportunity.

lanes.name: Assistant manager
cells: Readiness checklist run || Day-one checklist: uniform, ID, learning, roster, buddy.
Welcome and first-day brief || Owns the first-day script and the station tour.
Coaches on shift || Two weeks of coaching beats classroom content.
Skill-mix reviews || Roster composition checked against capability, not only headcount.
Feedback and recognition || Recognition during learning, not only after mastery.
Cross-training plan || The roster builds toward a visible next step.

lanes.name: Restaurant manager
cells: Names the buddy and trainer || Assigned before day one, not improvised on shift.
Schedules the check-in || The two-week check-in is a calendar event.
Roster consistency review || Hours matched to agreed availability: the root cause behind 'more hours' and 'more people' at once.
Escalation path || Maintenance, equipment and staffing issues get a named owner and a response time.
Recognition and career conversation || Progress made visible; the twelve-week conversation is scheduled.
Signs off independence || With evidence, not tenure.

lanes.name: Above-store and support
cells: Systems access provisioned || User ID, learning access and uniform logistics confirmed before day one.
Maintenance queue || First-shift equipment failures route to a named owner.
Learning content live || The training plan on the learner dashboard.
Labour model support || Peak labour plans reviewed against skill mix.
Area coach follow-up || Verifies the first-twelve-weeks standard in the restaurant.
Retention analytics || Tenure-by-wave dashboards feed the next cycle.

lanes.name: Measures
cells: Day-one readiness complete || Uniform, ID, learning, roster, buddy: five yes-or-no gates.
First shift ran to the script || Welcome, tour, first station, who-to-ask card.
Two-week check-in done || Structured plan exists, hours match, welcomed.
Six-week progress || Station sign-offs, feedback received, roster consistency.
Twelve-week outcome || Independence, recognition, intent to stay, next step named.
Tenure by wave || Retention at 30, 60 and 90 days; exit reasons.

lanes.name: Failure points
cells: F-01 Missing uniform, no user ID || Pre-boarding fails before day one.
F-02 No named trainer || The first shift is improvised.
F-03 No plan, no check-in || Few new starters have either.
F-04 Hours not matched to availability || Pressured shifts and the wrong skill mix.
F-05 Effort unseen, no path visible || Limited progress leads to avoidable exits.
F-06 Independence by tenure || Signed off by time served, not evidence.
